title: UPA Research
description: Research organized through the UPA Grid for traceability, segmentation, and cross-linking.

projects.name: UPA Core
projects.summary: The conceptual and methodological foundation of Universal Pattern Application, including parametric representation, pattern matching, structured state spaces, and traceable application workflows.

projects.name: PAG — Pattern Atlas Generator
projects.summary: A research platform for generating, detecting, analyzing, and cataloguing recurring arithmetic and digit patterns to build a Pattern Atlas.

projects.name: PAAL — Pattern-Adaptive Arithmetic Library
projects.summary: A proposed arithmetic-library approach that identifies structured numerical families and uses exact formulas or compact lookup structures where appropriate.
